text: The National Maritime Museum of China is a public cultural institution co-built and co-managed by China's Ministry of Natural Resources and the Tianjin Municipal People's Government, and directly under the Binhai New Area People's Government.
short: The National Maritime Museum of China is a public institution co-managed by the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Tianjin municipal government.

source.name: 新华网客户端 (Xinhua News Agency client): 国家海洋博物馆 (National Maritime Museum of China)
source.quote: 自然资源部与天津市人民政府共建共管、滨海新区人民政府直属的公益二类文化事业单位
source.note: Translation: '...a public-benefit category-two cultural institution co-built and co-managed by the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Tianjin Municipal People's Government, directly under the Binhai New Area People's Government.' The museum's own site (www.nmmc.cc/intro) carries the same sentence but renders it with JavaScript, so a script sees only an empty shell.

additionalSources.name: 中国航海学会 (China Institute of Navigation): 天津国家海洋博物馆 (Tianjin National Maritime Museum)
additionalSources.quote: 自然资源部与天津市人民政府共建共管、滨海新区人民政府直属的公益二类文化事业单位
additionalSources.note: Translation: '...co-built and co-managed by the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Tianjin Municipal People's Government, a public-benefit category-two cultural institution directly under the Binhai New Area People's Government.' Institute's popular-science base page for the museum.
